descriptions.text: Superb Constitution Buff Potion. Drinking this mixture will permanently increase your Constitution by a random number between one and four. You may only drink two of these during your time in the dungeon. Why? Because drinking more would be cheating. And if anyone is going to cheat, it's going to be me.

recap.text: Mordecai hands Donut his second pair of stat potions, since only two can be taken. The first raises her Constitution by one, and she asks whether he made it right while he rolls his eyes through her countdown. The second adds three, four in all, for a base of eight and 21 with her anklet, her brush's buff and the temporary ten from her Hooligan class. Four is good, Mordecai says, but much too low.

beats.headline: Two for Donut
beats.text: Mordecai's second pair of potions are both for Donut. Stat potions, he says: you can only take two, so take them both now. When he has the ingredients he will make two of these for everybody, with all of the stats, and anything like them they find before then should go undrunk unless it is labelled Superb, the only kind he can make that might add four. The two-potion limit does not care about quality. There is another kind, the Cosmic Buff, which raises a random stat by ten, but he does not know the recipe and has only seen a handful.
beats.gist: Mordecai tells Donut to drink both stat potions now, since two is the limit.

beats.headline: Well, that was a waste
beats.text: Donut drinks the first. It only went up one point, she complains, and asks Mordecai if he is sure he made them right. They wait for her potion countdown to wear off while he rolls his eyes at the cat. The second raises it by three, a net gain of four, for a base Constitution of eight. With her anklet, the buff from her brush and the temporary ten from her Hooligan class on this floor, she has a Constitution of 21. Four points is good, says Mordecai, but it is still much too low.
beats.gist: Donut drinks two stat potions, ending with Constitution 21 after Mordecai calls her four-point gain still too low.
